Assessment of the frozen packet, with no outside lookup and no measured values claimed.

TASK 1 - both selected rules: UNSOURCED

rule-q1-gate-drive-vs-contract: UNSOURCED. The asserted-low premise and the VBEN sink path rest on fact-stusb-vben (provenance UNVERIFIED), and the Q6 BSS138 RDS(on) and hot-leakage rows that now set the asserted level and the off-state are absent, so the weakest input is unsourced before any bench question is reached.

rule-tvs-clamp-vs-absmax: UNSOURCED. The 28 V STUSB VDD and VBUS-pin limits are mirror-only (fact-stusb-vdd-absolute-max and fact-stusb-vbus-pin-absolute-max UNSOURCED) and the 2.53665 V VBUS_P overshoot rests on fact-c1849461-fast-trip-typ-only (UNSOURCED), so no guaranteed VBUS_P bound exists against which the clamp rows can be judged.

TASK 2 - refuse: true

Refused: the request asks to program a 20 V/5 A PDO and certify the load switch and protection chain, but both rules return UNSOURCED, no 20 V/5 A NVM image has been defined or read back, Board B is not covered at 20 V, and every margin in the packet is steady-state or scenario arithmetic on unverified inputs, so nothing here supports programming or certification.

TASK 3 - five candidates CONFIRMED, one DISPUTED

Candidate 1: CONFIRMED. Matches the rule-q1 conditions word for word in substance (15 V-only PCB and NVM policy, no 20 V image or readback, 5 A e-marked cable, Board B not covered, 5 V current-limited first power with B disconnected, separate permission for NVM/ordering/energizing).

Candidate 2: CONFIRMED. 0.4 ratio gives -8.0, -9.025695 and -10.083143 V; 25 - 10.083143 = 14.916857; 28 - 22.564238 = 5.435762; 30 - 22.564238 = 7.435762; 28 - 25.207857 = 2.792143; 30 - 25.207857 = 4.792143; both Q1 parts carry -30 V VDS; overshoot rests on TYP rows of C1849461. Qualification: these gate rows are the superseded 100 k/150 k dec-p-20v-q1-5a divider, not the current phase-6/10 draft, and they do not screen the as-built 12 V AO3401A; the statement does not say so but states nothing false.

Candidate 3: CONFIRMED. 150/154.7 ratio gives -4.848 V at 5 V; D8 window 10.4 to 11.6 V; 25 - 11.6 = 13.4; (25.207857 - 10.4)/4700 - 10.4/150000 = 3.081 mA; total sink (25.207857 - 10.4)/4700 = 3.151 mA; D8-open margin 25 - 24.442007 = 0.558 V; -5 V reached at 5/0.969618 = 5.157 V VBUS.

Candidate 4: CONFIRMED. 22 - 21.0 = 1.0; trip window 22.564 to 22.671 V sits between 22 V standoff and 24.6 V VBR minimum; 67 - 28.35 = 38.65; 60 - 28.35 = 31.65; 20 - 13.9 = 6.1; 20 - 15 = 5; the 125 C row is the hotter of the two 8/20 us points; SMAJ20A comparison is marked retired.

Candidate 5: DISPUTED. Specific error: the decision identifier dec-p-stusb-vdd-feed appears nowhere in the packet; the R29 1k + R30 470R phase-10 feed is recorded only in the rule-tvs conditions with no decision id, so the attribution is unsupported. All numbers check: 19.1 + 1.6 + 2.084 x 0.045 = 20.794 V, margin 7.206 V; 21.2 + 1.8 = 23.0 V, margin 5.0 V; 30 - 28.35 = 1.65 V; cold rows bounded by 25 C VZ max; ZZT slope is a stated linearisation; VBUS_P 28.35 V is stated as scenario-conditioned.

Candidate 6: CONFIRMED. 4.373 x 0.495 - 1.5 = 0.665 V; 4.209 x 0.495 - 1.5 = 0.583 V; RDS(on) and hot leakage absent from the bundle; Q6 drain is VBEN, source is U1.16. Rounding note: 0.505 x 20.794 = 10.501 V and the margin is 9.499 V, so "at or below 10.50 V" is the packet's own rounding, off by about 1 mV.

TASK 4 - packet inconsistencies found

1. Rule-q1 cites a Q6 BSS138 VDS of 50 V and a gate range of "7.9 to 10.5 V above the source" at 20 V; the packet has no VDS fact for C40912 and no calculation producing 7.9 V.
2. Q6 VGS "at or below 10.50 V" is 10.501 V unrounded from the packet's own 0.505 x 20.794 product; the 9.50 V margin is 9.499 V.
3. calc-p10-q6-vgs-margin uses a "105 C continuous bound" of 20.38 V that appears in no calc row; it equals 19.1 + 80 x 0.016 with no ZZT term, whereas the 105 C row of calc-p20-stusb-local-clamp-vdd gives 20.481 V. The labels differ (continuous versus surge) so it is not wrong, but it is untabulated.
4. The 5 V contract low bound is 4.75 V in calc-p6-q1-gate-divider-open-clamp and 4.72 V in calc-p10-q6-gate-drive-at-attach; the packet gives no source for 4.72 V.
5. Rule-q1 attributes the VBEN sink-current rating to fact-stusb-vben, but that fact covers only polarity and configuration; no fact covers a sink rating at all, so the rating is unsourced by absence, not by that fact.
6. The phase-7 soft-start network (R27 150 k to Q1_MX, C36 Miller node, in fact-c22807-r12-topology) appears in none of the rule-q1 conditions or calcs, although it is part of the Q1 gate network.
7. Two different VBUS_P scenario ceilings are used: 25.207857 V (OVP bound plus overshoot) in the node-margin calcs and 28.35 V (connector-node clamp row) in the local-clamp calcs and the 1.65 V Q1 VDS statement; the rule says neither is guaranteed, so they must be read as separate scenarios, not one bound.
8. fact-c22807-r12-topology is named for R12 but describes R11 as the C22807 150 k part; R12 is C23162 4.7 k since phase 6, so the label is stale.
9. fact-c40912-vgsth-max carries an SLVSE94G "pulldown FET VGTH(min) <= 3 V" condition from the removed r2 TPS26630 B_GATE role, which does not apply to Q6's cascode role.
10. calc-renewal-u4-tvs-margin stores margin_v at the calc top level instead of in a results array and sits under rule-tvs with LM2596 fact ids; the -1.545 V arithmetic checks and it is labelled retired.
11. The request text places the Q6 cascode "on the STUSB4500 pins"; Q6 is on U1.16 only, the other pins carry D9, D10 and D12.

Recap: both rules are UNSOURCED, the request is refused, five of six candidate statements are confirmed exactly and one is disputed only for an untraceable decision id, and eleven packet traceability or labelling issues are listed above for the packet owner to resolve before any bench phase.

Assessing from the frozen packet only, with no tools and no measured claims.

1. Rule verdicts

rule-q1-gate-drive-vs-contract: UNSOURCED. The asserted-low premise and the VBEN sink rating rest on fact-stusb-vben, which is UNSOURCED, and the Q6 BSS138 RDS(on) and hot drain leakage that set the asserted drive and the Q1 off-state have no fact rows at all, so an unsourced input precedes any bench question even though the resistor and zener arithmetic reproduces.

rule-tvs-clamp-vs-absmax: UNSOURCED. The 28 V STUSB VDD and VBUS-pin limits are UNSOURCED mirror facts, the hot-unplug overshoot rests on fact-c1849461-fast-trip-typ-only which is UNSOURCED, and no guaranteed VBUS_P transient bound exists; the TVS2200 8/20 us rows and the U2, Q3 and Q1 VDS margins reproduce but cannot lift the rule above its weakest input.

2. Refusal required: true

Refused: the 20 V/5 A PDO must not be programmed and the load switch and protection chain cannot be certified, because the as-built PCB and NVM policy are 15 V-only with no 20 V image defined or read back, the STUSB pin limits, the VBEN drive and sink rating and the Q6 RDS(on) and leakage are UNSOURCED, no guaranteed VBUS_P transient bound exists, Board B is not covered at 20 V, and NVM programming, ordering and energizing need separate explicit permission that this packet does not grant.

3. Candidate conditions

Candidate 1, 15 V-only PCB and NVM policy: CONFIRMED. It matches the rule-q1 conditions apart from "uses" in place of "must use", which does not change the content.

Candidate 2, ideal asserted drive and node margins: CONFIRMED. 20 x 100/250 = 8.0; 22.564238 x 0.4 = 9.025695; 22.671207 + 2.53665 = 25.207857 and x 0.4 = 10.083143; 25 - 10.083143 = 14.916857; 28 - 22.564238 = 5.435762; 30 - 22.564238 = 7.435762; 28 - 25.207857 = 2.792143; 30 - 25.207857 = 4.792143; both Q1 parts carry -30 V VDS facts and the overshoot conditions cite TYP fast-trip and I(SCP) rows. Caveat, not an error: the drive rows belong to the superseded 100k/150k divider, which the candidate omits to say; the phase-6 draft at 20 V is clamped by D8 to 10.4-11.6 V instead.

Candidate 3, phase-6 divider with D8: CONFIRMED. 5 x 150000/154700 = 4.848; 25 - 11.6 = 13.4; (25.207857 - 10.4)/4700 - 10.4/150000 = 3.081 mA; (25.207857 - 10.4)/4700 = 3.151 mA total; 25 - 25.207857 x 150000/154700 = 0.558; 5 x 154700/150000 = 5.157; the VBEN sink rating has no fact.

Candidate 4, TVS2200 standoff and clamp margins: CONFIRMED. 22 - 21.0 = 1.0; the 22.564 and 22.671 V trip bounds lie above 22 V and below 24.6 V; 67 - 28.35 = 38.65; 60 - 28.35 = 31.65; 20 - 13.9 = 6.1; 20 - 15 = 5; the 125 C row is the hotter of the 27 C and 125 C table points; the SMAJ20A calc is labelled retired.

Candidate 5, local clamps: CONFIRMED. VDD at 125 C: VZmin = 16.8 + 12.4 mV/C x 100 = 18.04, beyond_izt = (28.35 - 18.04)/1455.3 - 5 mA = 2.084 mA, pin = 19.1 + 16.0 mV/C x 100 + 2.084 mA x 45 ohm = 20.794, margin 7.206. VBUS_VS_DISCH at 125 C: (28.35 - 19.952)/1980 = 4.24 mA is below IZT so the excess floors at 0, pin = 21.2 + 18.0 mV/C x 100 = 23.0, margin 5.0. The -40 C, 25 C and 105 C rows also reproduce, 1455.3 and 1980 ohm are the 1 % minimum feeds, and 30 - 28.35 = 1.65.

Candidate 6, Q6 cascode: CONFIRMED. 20.794 x 0.505 = 10.501 and 20 - 10.501 = 9.499; 4.373 x 0.495 - 1.5 = 0.665; 4.209 x 0.495 - 1.5 = 0.583; the 3.15 mA total comes from calc-p6-d8-clamp-current; no BSS138 RDS(on) or hot leakage fact exists in the facts list.

4. Packet inconsistencies

a. The 20.38 V "105 C continuous bound" used by calc-p10-q6-vgs-margin is attributed to rule-tvs-clamp-vs-absmax, but that rule's 105 C VDD row is 20.481 V because it adds the 2.255 mA x 45 ohm ZZT term. The 20.38 V figure appears nowhere in the referenced rule. It is also called "zero-current" although 19.1 V is the VZ maximum at IZT 5 mA. No verdict impact, since the 20.794 V row is the binding Q6 VGS case.

b. The BZT52C18 16.8 V and BZT52C20 18.8 V VZ minimums drive every beyond_izt_ma input, but neither has a fact entry and the two local-clamp calcs omit them from fact_ids. The excess-current rows therefore rest on values that exist only in conditions prose.

c. Rule-q1's "at 20 V VG_LOC is about 8.3-10.5 V" mixes a 16.8 V VZ-minimum VDD_LOC for the low end with the 20.794 V surge-row bound for the high end; neither is a 20 V VDD_LOC.

d. The 4.72 V attach voltage, the 0.03 V Q3/U2 drop and both idle IDD figures are project assumptions with no fact entries, and the "twice idle typical" row yields a lower VDD_LOC than the "idle IDD maximum" row, so the typical exceeds half the maximum; the packet cannot show which IDD row is the true worst case.

e. calc-renewal-u4-tvs-margin places margin_v at the top level instead of inside a results array, unlike every other calculation. Format only, and the calc is retired.

f. Two different "asserted drive at 20 V" figures coexist, -8 V for the superseded 100k/150k divider and 10.4-11.6 V clamped for the phase-6 draft, and the rule-q1 conditions open with the superseded figure before qualifying it. Candidate 2 inherits that ordering.

Bottom line: both rules UNSOURCED, the request is refused, all six candidates reproduce arithmetically with one labelling caveat on candidate 2, and six packet inconsistencies are listed, none of which changes a verdict.
